verdict.rationale: A single community comment says Grok Build runs in a terminal ("terminal is nice"), which suggests an xAI command-line interface exists. The first-party docs only reference Grok Build as a model name in the API quickstart and never document a CLI. missing for 10: first-party CLI documentation (install, commands, auth), evidence the terminal tool is official, details on agentic or scripting workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration.
